title: Nvidia beat earnings again — and the stock dropped

beats.narration: Nvidia beat earnings again — and the stock dropped anyway.
Revenue hit 44 billion dollars, up 69% from a year ago, almost all of it from AI data centers.
Next quarter's guidance landed near 45 billion dollars, just ahead of what analysts expected.
The problem wasn't the numbers. It was expectations — perfection was already priced in.
Every major AI lab still trains on Nvidia chips, from OpenAI to Anthropic to Google.
And CEO Jensen Huang said demand for the new Blackwell systems is, in his word, insane.
When a record quarter still isn't enough, you can see how high the bar has climbed. Follow for more.
